# BacktickWrapController

> Watches for paired backtick delimiters in a contenteditable input. When the user types a closing backtick that matches an opening backtick, the text between them is wrapped in a styled <code> element. Also wraps selected text when backtick is typed with an active selection. Single-line only (does not cross newlines). Events: - `native:backtick-wrap` — dispatched on host when text is wrapped. Detail: `{ text, element }`

**Trait name:** `backtick-wrap` (for use with `<n-controller traits="backtick-wrap">` or self-trait `traits="backtick-wrap"`)

## Constructor

```ts
new BacktickWrapController(host: HTMLElement, options?: BacktickWrapOptions)
```

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `input` | `HTMLElement` | yes |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no |  |

## Accessibility

### Keyboard

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| ``` | Wraps text between paired backticks or selected text in <code> |

## Behavior

- **Closing backtick typed after an opening backtick** → Walks backward from caret to find matching opening backtick, Extracts text between the backtick pair, Replaces the backtick-delimited range with a <code> element, Dispatches native:backtick-wrap with text and element
- **Backtick typed with active text selection** → Wraps the selected text in a <code> element, Dispatches native:backtick-wrap with text and element
- **Empty backtick pair (``)** → No-op — types normally
- **Modifier key + backtick (Cmd/Ctrl/Alt)** → Ignored — modifier combinations pass through

## Consumption Patterns

### 1. Imperative (Controller)

```ts
import { BacktickWrapController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new BacktickWrapController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```

### 2. Declarative (Provider)

```html
<n-controller traits="backtick-wrap">
  <div>Target element</div>
</n-controller>
```

### 3. Self-trait

```html
<n-button traits="backtick-wrap">Self-applying</n-button>
```

### Trait Option Attributes

When used as a provider or self-trait, options are passed via `data-trait-backtick-wrap-*` attributes:

```html
<n-controller traits="backtick-wrap" data-trait-backtick-wrap-input="value">
  <div>Target</div>
</n-controller>
```
